sources.snippet: SatQuery AI is an interactive, agentic vision-language assistant for Earth Observation (EO) and remote sensing data. Instead of applying a single generic model, SatQuery AI automatically interprets natural language queries, validates input modalities, selects specialist remote-sensing tools, and returns evidence-grounded spatial and textual insights with transparent provenance.
